description: This Mendeley Data release maps drought across the Sahelian climate zone of Niger for 2000–2020. The research team combines CHIRPS rainfall with MODIS vegetation indices and land-surface temperature to derive a composite drought index and drought classes at 1 km resolution. Version 6 provides netCDF layers for the index and contributing seasonal variables, with a country shapefile and figure images. The data are freely available under CC BY 4.0. They can support agricultural-water and drought-exposure simulations in areas with sparse station observations. Remote-sensing uncertainty and the index weighting limit interpretation as measured water deficits. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
name: Dataset of a composite drought index based on remote sensing data for Niger
